comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus replace a selected DIN-rail fuse and relatch its carrier.
comparison.physical_skill: Setscrew engagement and collar tuning versus carrier opening, small-cylinder extraction/insertion, selection, and closure.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe repeatable stops and lock retention versus correct KTK-6 fuse seated, carrier shut and holding under a 4 N pull, with wrong holders untouched.
comparison.reason: Both include opening and secure reclosure, but fuse selection/insertion does not test response-based mechanical tuning. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift limits remain missing.
